title: On-Peak Share of Estimated Net Energy Metering Exports
content:
The estimated export kWh of a Net Energy Metering export credit are divided between on-peak and off-peak by an on-peak share, which depends on whether the export window of the rider has on-peak hours and on the season of the estimated period's bill.

**When the export window has on-peak hours.** The export window has on-peak hours under every rider valued at the avoided-cost export rates — Rider NBT-R Residential Net Billing Tariff, Rider NBT-C Commercial Net Billing Tariff and Rider NBT-L Large Customer Net Billing Tariff — and, under the retail-valued riders — Rider NEM-L Legacy Net Energy Metering, Rider NEM-R Residential Net Energy Metering and Rider NEM-A Aggregated Net Energy Metering — when the rate schedule of the Electric Service Agreement hosting the system has on-peak hours.

**Rule.** When the export window has on-peak hours and the estimated period's bill is a winter bill, the on-peak share is the winter on-peak share of 0.16. When the export window has on-peak hours and the estimated period's bill is a summer bill, the on-peak share is the preceding export credit's on-peak export kWh divided by its total export kWh, rounded to four decimals. When the export window has no on-peak hours, no on-peak share arises.

The estimated period's bill is the most recent service bill of the hosting Electric Service Agreement, and its season is the pricing season printed on it. The preceding export credit is the most recent export credit in the net metering history.

## On-peak share

| Rider | Hosting schedule | Estimated period's bill | On-peak share |
|---|---|---|---|
| Avoided-cost rider | Any | Winter | 0.16 |
| Avoided-cost rider | Any | Summer | Preceding credit's on-peak kWh divided by its total, to four decimals |
| Retail-valued rider | Has on-peak hours | Winter | 0.16 |
| Retail-valued rider | Has on-peak hours | Summer | Preceding credit's on-peak kWh divided by its total, to four decimals |
| Retail-valued rider | No on-peak hours (flat) | Any | No on-peak share |

## Hypothetical worked case

Hypothetical inputs: a preceding export credit of 132 kWh on-peak and 468 kWh off-peak. On a summer bill the share is 132 divided by 600, that is 0.2200; on a winter bill it is 0.16.
